chapter1.str: The first gateway of the Pyramid Expedition welcomes you.\nThe light shining through the pillars illuminates the dark interior, but reveals only danger.\nWhat awaits you within the mysterious chambers ahead?

chapter2.str: You approach the second gateway of the pyramid expedition.\nThe desert sands glitter like treasure -- and they flow like empty dust.\nWhat lurks in these remains of long-gone glory?

chapter3.str: The pyramid expedition's third gateway leads you to a new abyss.\nA pit of heat and darkness, which has swallowed the glory -- and the mistakes -- of the past.\nCan you endure the heat and push forward?

chapter4.str: You break through the abyss and come to the fourth gateway. At the unknown end of the Magma Dungeon's abyss, you face the darkness deep within yourself, the darkness of desire and temptation. Will your wisdom and courage persevere, or will you join the past's remains in the pit of darkness?

chapter5.str: You have reached the final gateway of the Pyramid Expedition.\nHere, in this place of shining glory, your greatest trial awaits. Witness pain that no golden hoard could ever bury, and bring it to an end if you can.\nWill the Pharaoh find eternal rest at last?

challenge.str:
Pharaoh is resting now, but the Pyramid still holds many mysteries. Challenge the unknown! Challenge your limits!
Until all falls back to the desert sands...

Quickly wield a dagger in front to inflict consecutive damage.

Additional linked attacks briefly increase Attack Speed.

Quickly wield a dagger in front to inflict consecutive damage.

Additional linked attacks briefly increase Attack Speed.
Briefly increases damage taken by any enemies hit by the final attack.

50000000.name: Shotgun Fire Lv. 1
50000000.desc:
Wreak havoc to the front with explosively powerful shooting. 
Consecutively hit the button to link additional shots, leading up to a final shot.

50000001.name: Shotgun Fire Lv. 2
50000001.desc:
Wreak havoc to the front with explosively powerful shooting. 
Consecutively hit the button to link additional shots, leading up to a final shot.
Once you've fired additional shots and the final shot, there's a set chance to throw an even more powerful bomb to the front.

Enemies Hit: #x1, Damage: #x2% of Attack Power, Number of Attacks: #x3
Enemies Hit By Additional Shots: #y1, Damage: #y2%, Number of Attacks: #y3
Enemies Hit By Final Shot: #z1, Damage: #z2%, Number of Attacks: #z3
Once you've fired additional shots and the final shot, there's a set chance to throw a Grenade to the front.
Grenades explode when they come in contact with the target and terrain. Enemies Hit: #a1, Damage: #a2% of Attack Power, Number of Attacks: #a3.

50000002.name: Shotgun Fire Lv. 3
50000002.desc:
Wreak havoc to the front with explosively powerful shooting. 
Consecutively hit the button to link additional shots, leading up to a final shot.
Hold the key down to charge the final shot before letting it go.
Once you've fired additional shots and the final shot, there's a set chance to throw an even more powerful bomb to the front.
50000002.h:
Enemies Hit: #x1, Damage: #x2% of Attack Power, Number of Attacks: #x3
Enemies Hit By Additional Shots: #y1, Damage: #y2%, Number of Attacks: #y3
Enemies Hit By Final Shot: #z1, Damage: #z2%, Number of Attacks: #z3, Damage Boost With Key Down: #z4%
Activates enhanced Final Shot with Max Boost Enemies Hit: #zz1, Damage: #zz2%, Number of Hits: #zz3
Once you've fired additional shots and the final shot, there's a set chance to throw an Enhanced Grenade to the front.
Enhanced Grenades explode when they come in contact with the target and terrain. Enemies Hit: #a1, Damage: #a2% of Attack Power, Number of Attacks: #a3
Charging the final shot increases chances of Enhanced Grenade Attacks.
